rules: Lead with the strongest tech or programming story of the day.
Cover every newsletter at least once.
Merge the same story from different newsletters into one segment.
Keep any single story under about 90 seconds.
If there is a light or funny story, save it for last, just before the sign-off.
Skip sponsored content, job posts, and product promotions.
